title: Essential AIRPORT Vocabulary✈️ -- SLOW English Podcast for A2 Beginners

header.titleZh: 機場必備詞彙✈️ -- A2 初學者的 SLOW 英語播客
header.titleEn: Essential AIRPORT Vocabulary✈️ -- SLOW English Podcast for A2 Beginners

sentences.en: Welcome back to my slow English podcast a comprehensible and clear way of listening to English practice repeating any words you don't understand.
sentences.tc: 歡迎回到我的慢速英語播客，這是一​​種可以理解且清晰的方式來聽英語練習重複任何您不明白的單字。

sentences.en: First and try to listen without reading the subtitles.
sentences.tc: 首先嘗試在不看字幕的情況下聽。

sentences.en: Today I want to talk to you about some common conversations or words.
sentences.tc: 今天我想和大家聊一些常見的對話或單字。

sentences.en: You can use at the airport when I arrive at the airport.
sentences.tc: 當我到達機場時，您可以在機場使用。

tags.note: 看到 airport 時，先聽它前後搭配的字，再練習放進自己的句子。

sentences.en: I always make sure I have my passport my boarding pass and and all of my luggage those three things are essential to check.
sentences.tc: 我總是確保我有護照、登機證和所有行李，這三件事是必須檢查的。

sentences.en: I triple check before I leave my house and when I arrive at the airport once.
sentences.tc: 我在離開家之前和到達機場時都會檢查三次。

sentences.en: I get to the SEC security checkpoint I show my boarding pass to the security guard.
sentences.tc: 我到達 SEC 安檢站，向保全人員出示我的登機證。

sentences.en: They point me to which line I should go so I stand in line.
sentences.tc: 他們告訴我應該走哪條線，所以我就會排隊。

sentences.en: I wait I take off my shoes I take off my coat.
sentences.tc: 我等著，我脫掉鞋子，脫掉外套。

sentences.en: I take all my electronics out of my bag if I have headphones or a laptop or my phone and even my Chargers.
sentences.tc: 如果我有耳機、筆記型電腦、手機甚至充電器，我會把所有電子產品從包包裡拿出來。

sentences.en: I put them all in a basket.
sentences.tc: 我把它們都放在一個籃子裡。

sentences.en: Then I walk through the metal detector and I don't usually get checked for extra security.
sentences.tc: 然後我走過金屬探測器，通常不會接受額外的安全檢查。

sentences.en: They check with a little metal detector to see if I have any metal on my body.
sentences.tc: 他們用一個小型金屬探測器檢查我身上是否有任何金屬。

sentences.en: They will say.
sentences.tc: 他們會說。

sentences.en: Can you please step to the side?
sentences.tc: 可以請你到一邊去嗎？

sentences.en: They scan with their little metal detector once I had a big bottle of sunscreen lotion.
sentences.tc: 一旦我有一大瓶防曬霜，他們就會用小型金屬探測器掃描。

tags.meaning: 日常生活相關的常用字

sentences.en: They threw the whole thing in the garbage it was my fault because it was over 100 milliliters but I was still so angry.
sentences.tc: 他們把整個東西扔進了垃圾桶，這是我的錯，因為它超過了 100 毫升，但我仍然很生氣。

sentences.en: They could have just kept it for themselves or given it to somebody else it was very frustrating have.
sentences.tc: 他們本可以自己保留它或將其送給其他人，這是非常令人沮喪的。

sentences.en: You ever had anything taken away from you at the security checkpoint have.
sentences.tc: 您曾經在安全檢查站被拿走任何東西。

sentences.en: You ever been stopped and scanned at the security checkpoint after.
sentences.tc: 之後您曾在安全檢查站被攔截並接受掃描。

sentences.en: I get through the checkpoint I have to find my gate number usually my gate number is on my boarding pass but if it's not.
sentences.tc: 我通過檢查站時必須找到我的登機口號碼，通常我的登機口號碼在登機證上，但如果沒有的話。

sentences.en: I check the display screens at the airport I always check to see the time and the gate number haven't changed.
sentences.tc: 我檢查機場的顯示屏，我總是檢查時間和登機口號碼是否有變化。

sentences.en: I always make sure to ask the service agents if I have any questions at all once.
sentences.tc: 如果我有任何問題，我總是一定要立即詢問服務人員。

sentences.en: I find my gate.
sentences.tc: 我找到我的大門了。
